narr: In the early morning hours on May 10th, 2021, slow moving thunderstorms from a stalled frontal boundary delivered flash flooding to portions of the southshore of southeastern Louisiana.
ev: Several underpasses closed due to flooding in the city of New Orleans after 1.5 inches of rain in 30 minutes.
Numerous streets flooded in the Metairie area, with several vehicles stalled.
